observations.what: After entering the work email on smartsheet.com/try-it and clicking Continue, the app.smartsheet.com/b/signup page bounced back to the same email form with the email field emptied.
Retrying the same email led to a generic 'Sorry - an error has occurred' page on app.smartsheet.com/b/signup with only a contact-support link.
A second attempt from a fresh try-it page produced the identical error page, so no account could be created.
No verification email arrived after waiting about 45 seconds following the first submit.
The entry form asks for a work email and is paired with Google, Microsoft and Apple sign-in buttons, with a data region selector, and no visible plain free-signup path beyond the email.
I used an invalid action type 'goto' once before using 'navigate'; this cost no step.
